definitions.round_present: round has at least one row in grid.parquet with era 2026, and rounds.parquet has use == True for it
definitions.consecutive_pair: same match_key and round(r) - round(r-1) == 1, both rounds present; rounds sorted by round number within match
definitions.score_lead_diag: grid column = ct_sc - t_sc at freeze end (rounds.parquet, fill_null(0)); see scripts/data/make_grid.py line 75
definitions.sign: sign(x) = +1 if x > 0, -1 if x < 0; d == 0 pairs are excluded from all shares
definitions.prev: +1 if CT won round r-1 (grid label_ct_win = 1; equals rounds.final == 3), else -1
definitions.cur: +1 if CT won round r (grid label_ct_win = 1; equals rounds.final == 3), else -1
definitions.shares: share of pairs with d != 0 where sign(d) == prev, sign(d) == -prev, sign(d) == cur, sign(d) == -cur
definitions.side_swap: pair (r-1, r) crosses a side swap iff rounds.swap_boundary(r-1) is True; swap_boundary = prepare.swap_after(round, max_rounds_final) = (round == max_rounds_final // 2) or (round > max_rounds_final and (round - max_rounds_final - 3) % 6 == 0); recomputed from max_rounds_final and checked against the stored column
definitions.excluding_side_swap: same shares recomputed on pairs with prev_swap == False
definitions.prev_eq_cur_winner: diagnostic: share of pairs where the CT-win sign of round r-1 equals that of round r (a winner-repeat share, not a score-lead share)

reference.note: a binary sign over one denominator sums to 100; the reference pairs sum to about 95.5
